prompts.people:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished PEOPLE category background artwork for the Holocron native mobile app.
Primary request: three adult spacefaring adventurers seen from behind, walking toward the immense open door of a shadowy starship hangar. One wears a weathered pilot jacket and carries a helmet, one wears a long traveling cloak, and one wears rugged expedition clothing. A compact utility robot follows them. Their silhouettes are sharply rim-lit against a breathtaking amber starfield and the faint curved edge of a distant blue world. A story of exploration and companionship.
Style: cinematic realistic space-opera concept art with a classic Star Wars sense of adventure, tactile practical-film-set realism, deep graphite shadows, restrained amber and cyan palette, atmospheric depth. Original fictional adult characters and original composition, no visible faces.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024. Put the distinctive group in the upper center/right, leaving lower-left dark reflective hangar flooring as quiet space for native white headings. Essential subjects inside central 75% for phone crops. Full-bleed art, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI.
